title: ASEAN, India expand ties in digital tech, defense
summary: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and India are expanding their partnership in digital technologies, defense, and space, India Prime Minister Narendra Modi said Tuesday.

blocks.text: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and India are expanding their partnership in digital technologies, defense, and space, India Prime Minister Narendra Modi said Tuesday.

"Building on a shared culture and heritage, our partnership is now expanding into new areas of cooperation, such as digital technologies, defense, and space," Modi said during his speech at the ASEAN-India Summit in Pasay City.

"Between 2014 and now, we have undertaken over 100 initiatives to strengthen people-to-people ties. Over 250 quick-impact projects have been launched, and over 10,000 skill-building scholarships have been given," he added.
Meanwhile, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. underscored India's experience with digital infrastructure, which could widen access to services and markets.

"India's experience in digital public infrastructure and payments (1:51) also offers opportunities to widen access to services and markets (1:56) with the ASEAN-India Fund for Digital Future supporting cooperation in this area," Marcos said.

"We likewise look forward to strengthening cooperation on renewable energy,(2:09)energy efficiency, and the development of the ASEAN Power Grid (2:13) to advance regional energy security, as well as on cyber security,(2:19)sustainable infrastructure, and the green economy," he added.

The joint statement on disaster preparedness and management is expected to be adopted during the ASEAN-India Summit. It is a joint framework and collaborative efforts to reduce disaster risks and strengthen emergency response. —RF, GMA News
